reference_only: EEMB LP503030-PCM-LD, ZJQM-RD-SPC-A04005 rev 0.0. Its 350 mA PCM is not accepted for this request.
configuration: 1S rechargeable lithium-ion polymer, complete protected pack

discharge.basis: Engineering headroom for the whole device. Nordic specifies approximately 500 mA peak at 3.7 V, not 600 mA continuous.
discharge.pulse_qualification: Return the complete pack current-versus-duration/duty/temperature rating and PCM trip/recovery limits. Do not substitute a cell rating or an overcurrent-trip threshold for a load rating.

mechanical.dimension_scope: Requested bound including PCM, insulation and service swelling; supplier must explicitly confirm or return a revised drawing. The old EEMB drawing does not establish its end-of-life bound.

ntc.attachment: Flat against the broad insulated cell face; no fold or bare-cell soldering. Confirm the active sensing-area location, insulation, process and thermal lag before release.
ntc.tape_budget_basis: Assigned maximums, not manufacturer-guaranteed maxima. Typical published thicknesses are 0.125 mm and 0.07 mm; conversion tolerance and cell compatibility need approval.

factory_interface.connection: PCM protected negative output and sensor return
Other NTC terminal; no connection to cell positive

supplier_response_required: Controlled complete-pack part number, revision and dimensions including service swelling
Cell and PCM load limits, resistance, protection thresholds/delays and recovery behavior
Compatibility with 4.2 V charger tolerance, 112 mA upper current screen and charge termination
Cell-mounted NTC R/T limits, sensor placement, attachment and thermal response
Insulated wire/termination construction, current rating and strain relief
Current UN38.3 test summary and applicable cell/pack safety documents
Prototype availability, MOQ and lead time; no order is authorized
